subject_definitions:
<M1> is the young man whose facial identity, neat short black hair, and lean proportions come from Image 1. His wardrobe consists of a tailored black single-breasted suit, crisp white dress shirt, slim black satin tie, and polished black leather oxford shoes. Preserve his facial structure, jawline, hairstyle, height, build, and the precise cut and fit of his suit.
<W1> is the young woman whose facial identity, long straight black hair, and slender proportions come from Image 2. She wears a dark navy floral-print chiffon dress with an asymmetrical ruffled hem (shorter on the left), thin spaghetti straps, and a scalloped lace neckline, paired with thick-soled black platform sandals. Her hair is worn down with a small floral hair tie. Preserve her face, eye shape, long hair, figure, and the dress silhouette, floral pattern, and fabric drape.
<W2> is the young woman whose facial identity, long black hair tied in a low ponytail, and slim proportions come from Image 3. She wears a navy blue ribbed crop top, high-waisted white wide-leg trousers, clean white low-top sneakers, medium-sized pearl hoop earrings, and a delicate silver chain necklace. Preserve her face, ponytail hairstyle, figure, and the fit and texture of her casual outfit.

summary: [reference generation] Create a 15-second melodramatic short drama set at night in an upscale hotel lounge with cold neon and city-light reflections. <W2> storms in and confronts <M1> and <W1>, exposing a pregnancy that shatters the couple, with all three characters speaking Chinese dialogue.

retention_analysis:
<M1>: fully_preserved - retain his facial identity, short black hair, build, black suit, white shirt, black tie, and polished shoes throughout.
<W1>: fully_preserved - retain her facial identity, long black hair, slender figure, dark floral dress with asymmetric hem, lace neckline, and platform sandals.
<W2>: fully_preserved - retain her facial identity, low ponytail, slim figure, navy crop top, white wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, pearl earrings, and silver chain.

detailed_description: The target video uses polished cinematic realism with shallow depth of field, cold blue neon key light, and hard reflections on the lounge's marble floor. [Shot 1] A medium-wide shot opens on the dim lounge. <M1> in his black suit stands close to <W1> in her floral dress near the bar, his hand resting near hers. The camera tracks right as <W2> in white trousers and navy crop top strides into frame from the left, eyes locked on them, jaw tight. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a tight over-the-shoulder shot from behind <W2>. She points a trembling finger at <W1> and says with sharp, accusing lip movement: [中文] “你就是那个抢走我未婚夫的女人？” <W1> stiffens and steps back, her eyes widening. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a low-angle medium shot of <M1> wedged between them; he raises both palms and says, voice strained: [中文] “你们都先冷静一点……” <W2> shakes her head, tears welling, and cuts in, jabbing a finger at his chest: [中文] “冷静？我肚子里还怀着你的孩子！” <W1> clutches her chest, breath caught; the camera pushes in fast to her stricken face. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, a stable close-up on <W1> as she whispers, devastated: [中文] “原来……你一直在骗我。” She turns and walks out of frame to the right; the camera holds on <M1> frozen mid-step, mouth open, city neon flickering across his face as the lounge falls silent.

overall_soundscape: A low lounge bass hum and faint clink of glass beneath the scene. Rapid determined footsteps as <W2> storms in. A sharp intake of breath from <W1> at the pregnancy reveal. The rustle of <W1>'s chiffon dress as she turns away. The dialogue stays clear above the ambient bass.

non_diegetic_music: Tense sustained string chords in a minor key with a slow pulsing low cello; the strings swell sharply at the pregnancy reveal, then drop to a single desolate piano note under the final shot that lingers and fades to silence.
